question: Coca-Cola has roughly half of PepsiCo's revenue. Which of the two earned more operating income in 2025, by how much, and what were their operating margins?
answer: PepsiCo earned more operating income in 2025 than Coca-Cola. PepsiCo's operating profit was $11,498 million ($11.498 billion) with an operating margin of 12.2%, while Coca-Cola's operating income was $13,762 million ($13.762 billion) with an operating margin of 28.7%. Wait, Coca-Cola's operating income is actually higher than PepsiCo's ($13,762 million vs $11,498 million). Therefore, Coca-Cola earned more by $2,264 million.
